text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "before firmware 5.0",
    "condition_is_relative": false,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "Bounce the interface",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Bounce the interface, don't reboot. FYI this stopped after firmware 5.0, so once your boxes are upgraded you won't see it anymore.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Did it, traffic back.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-087",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a fix (bounce the interface, don't reboot) for when an SFP swap leaves the link up with zero counters on boxes running firmware older than 5.0."
}
